title: Create offline workshop notification board
goal: completely presents the wait, success, empty list, failure and retry of asynchronous operations.
summary: workshop data comes from the embedded local response. Wait for a moment for each request to observe the status. Switching samples can check whether the failure can be recovered and whether the old list is cleared.
tasks: After clicking #refresh, the old list will be cleared immediately, "Loading" will be displayed and the button will be temporarily disabled. To read the current sample, call Fetch through the existing simulateWait and localUrl.
On success, display each notice as “TITLE · ROOM” and show “Loaded N notices” with the count. Display “No notification yet” if the list is empty.
Displays "Unable to read notification, please try again" when reading or parsing fails. Regardless of the result, re-enable the loading button when finished.

example.note: finally will be executed after success and failure, suitable for restoring temporarily disabled controls.

hint: Clearing old results and entering loading state is completed before try. Use textContent to always display the notification title as text.
